safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not address whether headaches radiate.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a headache radiates helps characterize headache type and can contribute to identifying secondary causes. Omitting this detail mainly reduces diagnostic specificity rather than directly changing immediate management.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting that this is a new headache (no prior headache history) is an important red-flag contextual factor that can increase urgency of evaluation for secondary causes. Omission could contribute to under-triage or delayed workup.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes feeling hot but does not state that headaches are accompanied by fevers/feeling hot.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Headache accompanied by fever/feeling hot is a potential red-flag constellation (e.g., infectious or inflammatory etiologies) that can materially affect urgency and differential. Omitting this association may reduce recognition of higher-risk conditions.
